beats.phrase: Applying less only works with aim.
beats.scene: FULL-SPREAD: a monochrome cutout figure stands on the cream stage aiming a single burnt orange arrow at one small distant target, no paper forms anywhere

beats.change_only: the single arrow lands in the centre of the target

beats.scene: MEDIUM: a torn paper grid board of small blank monochrome cards standing on the cream stage, a flat burnt orange disc behind it
CLOSE-UP: four empty vertical columns of blank paper strips on the cream stage, the leftmost column edged in burnt orange

beats.change_only: all four columns fill with rows of blank cards

beats.scene: MEDIUM: the first column of the grid board filling with small blank monochrome cards, a burnt orange stroke marking its top

beats.phrase: Set a timer for ten minutes.
beats.scene: CLOSE-UP: a monochrome halftone hourglass cutout on the cream stage with burnt orange sand in its upper bulb

beats.change_only: the burnt orange sand falls halfway through the hourglass

beats.scene: MEDIUM: the oversized monochrome hand reaching toward a card as if to remove it, a burnt orange cross stroke drawn over the hand

beats.change_only: the oversized hand withdraws from the board entirely

beats.scene: FULL-SPREAD: four dense columns of small blank monochrome cards filling the cream stage, one card in each column popped burnt orange

beats.change_only: every card in the grid snaps into alignment

beats.scene: MEDIUM: the grid board seen closer with the second column empty, a burnt orange bracket drawn around that empty column

beats.phrase: Advocacy. Who could speak for you?
beats.scene: MEDIUM: two monochrome cutout figures on the cream stage, one standing behind the other with a hand on their shoulder, a burnt orange stroke joining them

beats.phrase: Someone inside who knows your work.
beats.change_only: the standing figure steps closer behind the other

beats.scene: CLOSE-UP: a single monochrome book cutout on the cream stage with a burnt orange marker line struck through one blank region of its cover

beats.phrase: He used to say alumni first.
beats.change_only: the struck-through region on the cover fades to pale monochrome
a fresh burnt orange underline draws beneath a different region

beats.scene: MEDIUM: a monochrome cutout figure seated at a desk working, a second figure standing beside them watching, a burnt orange circle drawn around the seated one

beats.change_only: the standing watcher fades to pale monochrome

beats.scene: MEDIUM: the grid board with the third column empty, a large abstract burnt orange curl stroke drawn beside it

beats.change_only: the abstract orange curl beside the column doubles in size

beats.scene: CLOSE-UP: a single blank monochrome card held upright on the cream stage with a burnt orange marker circle drawn around it

beats.phrase: Half the list will fail it.
beats.change_only: half the cards behind it tip over and fall flat

beats.scene: MEDIUM: the grid board with the fourth and last column empty, a small burnt orange tick shape at its head

beats.change_only: the small orange tick shrinks to almost nothing

beats.phrase: A posting is a weak signal.
beats.scene: MEDIUM: a monochrome door cutout standing alone on the cream stage with a thin faint burnt orange stroke behind it

beats.change_only: the door tips forward revealing bare cream paper behind

beats.phrase: Advocacy and motivation carry the rank.
beats.scene: FULL-SPREAD: two tall dot-matrix columns on the cream stage dense with burnt orange dots, a third and fourth column beside them almost bare

beats.change_only: the two bare columns shrink further while the dense ones hold

beats.scene: MEDIUM: the grid of cards rearranged into a vertical ranked stack on the cream stage, the topmost card burnt orange

beats.change_only: the top five cards separate upward from the stack

beats.scene: FULL-SPREAD: one deep narrow burnt orange channel cut down through the cream stage beside a wide shallow monochrome smear

beats.phrase: Five conversations beat two hundred applications.
beats.scene: MEDIUM: five pinned photo cards in a tight row on the cream stage each with a burnt orange stroke, facing a huge faded monochrome drift of paper forms

beats.change_only: the faded monochrome drift of forms slides out of frame

beats.phrase: And the list does not expire.
beats.scene: MEDIUM: the grid board standing intact on the cream stage while a monochrome door cutout beside it crumbles away at the edges

beats.change_only: the crumbling door disappears entirely and the board is unchanged

beats.phrase: Reuse it for the next search.
beats.scene: FULL-SPREAD: the oversized monochrome hand lifting the whole grid board cleanly off the cream stage, a burnt orange stroke trailing it
CLOSE-UP: the monochrome hourglass with all the burnt orange sand run through into the lower bulb, a marker circle drawn around it

beats.change_only: a burnt orange arrow draws itself rising away from the hourglass
